name: Pippa
source:
Pippa is Aspen’s best friend. The pair met in primary school, and they’ve known one another for a decade.

Though Pippa and Aspen are close as can be, they’re polar opposites. Pippa is loud and boisterous where Aspen is quiet and reserved, and Pippa has no qualms about speaking her mind. Though Pippa could be described as the life of a party, she’s also something of a bully,
and she can turn nasty when she doesn’t get her own way.
